address: Rua Prudente Correia 432, São Paulo, 01450-030, Brazil
bio: For anyone keen to embark on a journey across Asian cuisine, Kazuo, in its location in the sophisticated Plaza Iguatemi, offers a unique experience under the command of chef Kazuo Harada, who explores the flavours of Japan, China, Malaysia, Thailand, Korea and even India. One of the features that sets it apart is the inter-connectivity of the dishes, which provide an exploration through the unique world of pan-Asian cooking (in particular, the continent’s hot dishes) through the use of interesting techniques and elaborately prepared recipes. The à la carte, with its numerous sushi, sashimi and temaki options and main courses such as Peking Duck, Wagyu ribs and” yellow curry” with seafood, is complemented by the Omakase served at the sushi bar, and a tasting menu.
